description: RFC 8621 compliance audit of jmap-mail-server found 9 confirmed gaps: 3 P0 spec violations that would break conforming clients (Email/get and Email/parse missing body-value fetch args + default property list enforcement, EmailSubmission sendAt validation), 4 P1 significant deviations (Email/set bodyStructure/bodyValues, keyword validation, EmailSubmission/query filter, Email/import alreadyExists), and 2 P2 partial implementations (dynamic header: property syntax, capability URI docs). Similar audit was run on jmap-chat-server (JMAP-x09). This epic tracks all RFC 8621 compliance work for the mail handlers.
notes: Child issues (P0): JMAP-6xv JMAP-wdp JMAP-iep | (P1): JMAP-0zj JMAP-b50 JMAP-fz8 JMAP-11t | (P2): JMAP-06p JMAP-skx
title: jmap-mail-server: RFC 8621 compliance gaps
